correctness.rationale: At a singular point with m nonzero coordinates, the derivative equations on their squares have eigenvalues 2-lambda and 2+(m-1)lambda, giving exactly the stated exclusions. The three disjoint line lists have 4+12+12 members and their binary restrictions are squares, so the odd-characteristic bitangent count gives completeness. The sign and mixed discriminants are in k, equal up to square factors to -3 and 3-lambda; when a line has degree two no contact on it can have degree one because a smooth contact point determines the tangent line. In the coordinate-zero group the discriminant is -4lambda/(1-w); the two choices differ by a square when both radicals are rational. If w is nonrational its quadratic norm is 16lambda^2/e. For nonzero lambda the norm criterion therefore gives unresolved contacts over the quadratic line field precisely when both d and e are nonsquares; if only e is nonsquare and w is rational, the discriminant is already in k. The reduced hyperflex support has one point per line at lambda=0 or 3 only; characteristic five excludes the latter fiber. The two-nonsquare character sum gives (q-chi(-1))/4; the excluded d=-3 has 1-d=4, and d=-1 at lambda=0 must be removed exactly for q=3 modulo 8. Unique tangents give disjoint supports, so the cycle counts and zeta factors follow. I tested the entire dual projective plane over the quadratic line field for each smooth prime-field parameter at p=5,7,11,13, using binary quartic square extraction rather than the radical line list; all cycle counts agreed. An additional scan over F25 checked all rational lines and degree-one contacts there, not the nonrational line orbits over F25. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/reproductions/ciani.py. The all-prime-power scope follows from the algebra, not these checks.

value.rationale: For the natural geometric collection of all theta contacts, the arithmetic data ask more than the field of its bitangent lines. The exact square-class obstruction and its prevalence characterize when the line field misses the contact field, give the actual reduced scheme zeta function, and distinguish this from a recalculation of line orbits or of a single special quartic. The motivation holds for the marked pencil, not for an unclaimed census of isomorphism classes.
